status: registered AFTER QB1's results were seen. QB1 is reported as INVALID: its positive control compared realised Bernoulli successes on independent random streams, so a learning router beat the oracle by chance in 15 of 20 seeds. QB1b changes the metric and the controls, not the world, the arms or the seeds; it is a corrected re-test, not a blind one.
design: as QB1 (4 clusters, 5 experts, 2000 rounds, 20 seeds, base seed 2026, same arms), plus the arm near_oracle_90 (best expert with probability 0.9, else uniform) used only by the positive control, plus the arms added40_nocheck / added40_scoutcheck (40% sybil records ADDED to the honest scout records, cap disabled, with and without the scout cross-check of dance.recruitment_weights(scout_bounds=...)).
primary_metric: last_half_expected: mean over rounds 1001-2000 of p(chosen expert) in the true table. It has no outcome noise, so it measures the routing decision only.

controls.positive_wiring: the oracle's last_half_expected >= every arm's in every seed (true by construction; a failure means the metric is wired wrongly)
controls.positive_discriminating: near_oracle_90 is strictly below the oracle and strictly above uniform on last_half_expected in every seed; if not, the metric cannot separate routers known to differ
controls.negative: flat world (every expert 0.55): cold Thompson's REALISED last-half success lies inside uniform's 95% interval over seeds and its regret is 0; a bandit that wins here means the harness leaks the answer

hypotheses.H1: cold Thompson beats uniform and the static keyword router on last_half_expected in at least 18 of 20 seeds each
hypotheses.H2: warm start from honest dances lowers early_regret (rounds 1-200) vs cold Thompson in at least 16 of 20 seeds
hypotheses.H3: with cap 0.5, replacing 40% of the records by sybils leaves mean last_half_expected within 0.03 of the honest warm start, AND the uncapped arm's gap is larger than the capped arm's
hypotheses.H4: with sybils added on top of honest scouts and no cap, the scout cross-check lowers early_regret vs no check in at least 16 of 20 seeds

decision_rule: the three controls decide validity; each hypothesis is reported supported or not
not_claimed: nothing about real models, developers or latency; one adversary model only; the scout cross-check assumes scouts are honest, which is exactly what a sybil would attack next
